text.text_excerpt: This is my favorite taco truck in the city. It sits in a parking lot near Winn Dixie on Chef Menteur Highway. This taco truck never disappoints! I always get the lengua tacos, burritos, or quesadillas. Lengua means tongue in Spanish and you literally get chopped up beef tongue (which is much more tender compared to regular beef). The thought of it may sound weird, but you'll be surprised on how good it is! With each to go box, they will give you a small container that will contain either green salsa (salsa verde) or spicy red salsa. My personal favorite is the salsa verde, which I add to every bite I take! Sometimes you'll order multiple tacos for your family and you'll end up with just o...

My bf and I would probably vote this place as the best taco truck in New Orleans. We live around the corner so we are always here. The prices are pretty awesome. The line is sometimes long but don't worry! It runs pretty fast. I can't even tell you my favorite taco from this place because everything on their menu is good. The are tacos are pretty flavorful and juicy. Let's not forget their sauces. Be careful, the red one is super hot. Like it clears my noise just by smelling it. Every time I recommend a friend to come here, everyone always come out satisfied. Therefore, this place will not disappoint you.

The best taco truck! Right in front of Winn Dixie on Chef Hwy. I know they have a few other la coyotas around the city and they are just as good. They just upped a few of the prices, but I'm not complaining bc everything is made to order and always delicious. The red sauce is my favorite! Most of the time it's super spicy and I drench it on everything. The green sauce is more mild and good too. Gorditas - I always get the beef and they are always super juicy. Cheese, meat, onions, cilantro inside of a fried corn tortilla. The red and green sauces mixed together with some lime make it even better. Tacos - tortillas are corn.
